title: A Symbolic Framework for Evaluating Mathematical Reasoning and Generalisation with Transformers

bias_targets.methodology: Applying an 'Expression Exchange' (EE) perturbation that swaps mathematical expressions on either side of an equality to test if models rely on the overrepresentation of functions on the left-hand side (LHS) of equations.

Perturbing mathematical derivations through 'Variable Renaming' (mapping standard symbols to out-of-vocabulary Greek letters) and 'Equation Conversion' to evaluate whether models rely on superficial textual patterns and specific text spans rather than underlying algorithmic and mathematical rules.
